items.heading: Explains the ten Sefirot of the circles that were revealed after the restriction, that the light of Ein Sof surrounds them, and that all the light of the Sefirot of the circles is imparted to them through the line. And it contains eleven matters: — The line is like a thin pipe
items.html: *1And this line is like 2a thin pipe, 3a single one, through which the waters of the upper light 4of Ein Sof spread out and extend to the worlds that are in the place of that air and space.

items.heading: The expansion of the light of Ein Sof into the space. The expansion was gradual, little by little
items.html: And behold, since the light of Ein Sof was drawn in the aspect of 5a straight line within that aforementioned space, it was not drawn and did not expand 6immediately all the way down. Rather, it expanded little by little, meaning that at first the line of light began to expand, and there, immediately 7at the beginning of its expansion in the secret of the line, it expanded and was drawn and became like 8a single round sphere all around.

items.heading: The circle is not attached to Ein Sof, but is connected to it through the line
items.html: And this circle was 9not attached to the light of Ein Sof that surrounds it on all its sides, 10for were it to become attached to it, the matter would revert to how it had been, and it would be nullified within the light of Ein Sof, and its own power would not be seen at all, and everything would be the light of Ein Sof alone, as at first. Therefore this circle is close to the circle of Ein Sof, yet not attached to it. 20And the entire root of the connection and attachment of that emanated circle with Ein Sof the Emanator 30is through that aforementioned line, by way of which light descends and is drawn from Ein Sof and is imparted to that circle.

items.heading: The light of Ein Sof surrounds and imparts to the circle from a distance
items.html: 40And Ein Sof surrounds and encompasses it on all its sides, for it, too, is in the aspect of a circle 50around it, and distant from it, as above. For it is necessary that the illumination of Ein Sof in the emanated beings come by way of that line alone, for had the light been drawn to them also through all that surrounds them, 60the emanated beings would have been, like the Emanator Himself, without 70limit or measure.

items.heading: The order in which the ten Sefirot of the circles emerged. The line is called Adam Kadmon
items.html: And behold, 80this first circle, the one most attached to Ein Sof, is the one called Keter of Adam Kadmon. Afterward this line expanded 90further and was drawn a little, and again formed a circle, 100and became a second circle within the first circle, and this is called 200the circle of Hochma of Adam Kadmon. It expanded still further downward, and again formed a circle, and became a third circle within the second circle, and is called 300the circle of Bina of Adam Kadmon. And in this manner it continued to expand and form circles, until the tenth circle, called the circle of Malchut 400of Adam Kadmon. Thus the matter of 1the ten Sefirot has been explained, that they were emanated in the secret of ten circles, 2one within the other.

items.heading: The line connects all the circles together
items.html: And behold, 3the aspect that connects all the circles together is this thin line that extends from Ein Sof, 4and passes 5and descends 6and is drawn from circle to circle, until 7the very end of all of them. And through this line, the light and the abundance needed by each and every one of them is drawn.

items.heading: Every world and every Sefira contains ten particular Sefirot, and particulars of particulars without end. The Sefirot of the circles surround one another like the layers of an onion
items.html: And behold, every world contains ten particular Sefirot, and every particular Sefira within every world 8contains ten Sefirot of particulars of particulars, and all of them are 9like the layers of an onion, one within the other, in the manner of the image of the spheres mentioned in the books of astronomy.

items.heading: Every circle that is closer to Ein Sof than another is considered higher and more excellent than the other, until this world, being the middle point that is farthest of all from Ein Sof, is utterly corporeal
items.html: Of every circle of all the worlds, which are within the space, 10whichever is closer to the light of Ein Sof than another is far higher and more excellent than the other, so that it is found that this earthly, material world is the middle, central point within all the circles, within all that aforementioned place of space and empty air. It is also removed from Ein Sof by a complete removal, more than all the worlds altogether. Therefore it is so corporeal and material, utterly corporeal, even while being a middle point within all the circles. Understand this well.
